prompt:
Create ONE NEW photorealistic portrait photograph FROM SCRATCH, using these actual references. This is a fresh reconstruction, not an incremental edit or trace of the synthetic person. It is the clean background for an interior book title page; no lettering, oval, border, captions or graphics. Output portrait ratio exactly 1101:1428 (approximately 185:240); maximum available native detail.

REFERENCE ROLES: Image 1 (original D portrait) is ONLY the selected COMPOSITION, garden scene, camera framing, late summer daylight, crops, and location/scale of John and the wheelbarrow on the right. The generated person's face and body in it are NOT authoritative: the user finds them odd. Images 2–5 are the authoritative camera evidence for JOHN. Image 2 is an original unretouched camera crop of John pushing this very wheelbarrow: use his REAL shoulder width, torso shape, head-to-body proportion, neck, natural upper-arm/forearm lengths, elbows, hand grips and working posture, and the actual barrow geometry. Image 3 is the actual J01 checked-shirt/old-jeans wardrobe and standing figure: use for the loose natural shirt drape, actual build, jeans and shoes. Image 4 is the actual frontal face close-up: use it for his identity and facial detail. Image 5 is the saved lowered-profile reference: consult it if the head inclines; follow the real nose, lower lip, chin and beard-to-neck slope.

Rebuild John convincingly as the same real person in the camera references, about 60, real facial asymmetry and ordinary skin texture, receding grey hair under his grey/charcoal baseball-style work cap, short grey beard. His narrow nose profile, eyes/brow spacing, mouth and chin must be faithful to the camera pictures, not a generic older gardener. No beautification, inflated cheekbones, projecting block chin, rounded beard tuft or oversized head. Use the actual normal build in image 2 and the full-body wardrobe image; no bulky short torso, elongated forearms, pinched hips or stubby legs. Head mostly level and directed near the camera as in image 2, with a relaxed natural expression. Do not reproduce the warped synthetic face, stance or anatomy in image 1. He wears the open checked overshirt, plain muted dark T-shirt, worn blue jeans and ordinary work shoes from the selected concept and J01. NO microphone, logos, text or gloves.

Action: John is comfortably WALKING forward, pushing the loaded wheelbarrow along the grass path on the RIGHT of the frame. Shoulders relaxed, weight and stride believable, one hand wrapped naturally around each of the two handles at a comfortable height, elbows slightly relaxed. Head, neck, shoulders, spine, pelvis, knees and feet must form one anatomically coherent person. Keep him a secondary background actor at approximately the same overall size and position as image 1; do not turn this into a close-up portrait. The wheelbarrow partially hides his lower body naturally, as in the real camera view. One front tyre touches the path; the resting legs are lifted while he pushes.

Wheelbarrow: the real worn black/dark-olive metal tray, modest mixed garden trimmings and hessian sack, long two handles, one black treaded tyre. Preserve the correct broad U-shaped pale metal front frame loop visible in image 2. It connects the two existing front frame rails, has clearance beside the tyre, and its rounded lower curve passes IN FRONT of the lower tyre face slightly above the ground-contact point. It is not a tight hoop dangling below the tyre, and there are no disconnected tubes, floating bars or extra wheels. The user likes this corrected wheelbarrow form; reproduce it accurately from the real camera evidence.

Garden/composition: retain the original D wide garden composition and place John/barrow in the RIGHT third, all comfortably within the frame. Left and lower-left contain lush distributed leafy vegetables, red/green lettuces, brassicas, climbing beans and modest flowers, with natural irregular growth, ordinary small insect marks and some soil visible. Keep the realistic grass path, pale-green shed towards upper-left/middle, distant tiled rooftops and the neighbour's hoop edge at far right. Keep camera perspective and distances faithful; no invented extra structures, no planted bed replacing a path. Real weathered slender bamboo with plausible crossings and joins. Photograph-like summer light and colour; no painterly smoothing, illustration, HDR, repeated plastic leaves or studio cut-out person. Leave the upper-left and left-middle as useful textured background for the existing white book lettering to be overlaid separately. Maintain roughly the same tonal balance as image 1. This is a complete fresh photograph, with the actual camera references overriding image 1 wherever person anatomy or likeness conflicts.
